lore: The shaman-queen of Yamatai has long been a figure of myth and mystery; taken as fact by some, sheer fairy tale by others. Only after the Shattering did the isle of Yamatai reappear in the waters of Izumo. Himiko works great magics that often aid Izumo’s forces, but whether out of patriotism or her own agenda remains a mystery.
